copy.headline: Texas prepares for emotional rivalry showdown at Texas A&M as postseason stakes rise
copy.caption: No. 5 Texas couldn't have asked for a much better performance heading into rivalry week. But after dismantling Arkansas 45-3 on Saturday, the Longhorns face a different challenge: keeping their emotions in check with their postseason hopes hanging in the balance.
